name: SARSILMAZ SAR9 SPORT GEN3 PLATINUM 9x19mm Semi Automatic Pistol
lead: The sporty member of the GEN3 series, the SAR9 SPORT GEN3 takes the criteria of its segment to a new level with the extraordinary performance it offers to its users.
description: Incorporating all the features of GEN3 technology, the SAR9 SPORT GEN3 reflects the perfect harmony of an ultra-lightweight polymer frame with a longer forged steel slide and high-alloy steel barrel than other members of the series. Like other GEN3s, the SAR9 SPORT GEN3 incorporates advanced design and engineering features, combining trigger safety, striker-fired system, and frame safety. The SAR9 SPORT GEN3 prioritizes safety thanks to its manual safety and loaded chamber indicator; and makes aiming easiest thanks to its 90-degree trigger break, short reset trigger, and enhanced trigger sensitivity. Advantages offered by the SAR9 SPORT GEN3 for sport shooters include a Picatinny rail compatible with all kinds of accessories, an 18-degree grip angle that provides superior control, a slide with enhanced grip serrations, wider and more numerous cooling cuts developed to ensure maximum performance in successive shots, and co-witness sights compatible with the red dot ready option.
